name: api-wrapper
description: Generic JIRA REST access goes through jira api, not hand-written curl.
prompt: Potřebuji raw JSON seznam komentářů na KNW-30344 pro jq. Jaký příkaz použiješ?
expected_behaviors: proposes `jira api GET issue/KNW-30344/comment` or `jira --json` variant if documented
does not paste curl -u user:token with credentials path
anti_patterns: constructs full curl command with JIRA_USER and JIRA_TOKEN
reads ~/.config/jira/credentials only to build a one-off curl
